name: Mulberry House
headline: Made in Derby
description: Mulberry House ushers in new life to the heart of central Derby at this landmark historic site. A short stroll from the River Derwent and nestled between Derby train station and Castleward Park, it offers a collection of 94 carefully crafted studios, one, two and three bedroom apartments set around a central gated courtyard, curated for modern living and set amongst organic landscapes and peaceful surroundings. As the cornerstone of the wider Castleward Urban Village regeneration, Mulberry House blends industrial-luxe design with 21st-century style.
highlightedFeatures: Set around a central gated courtyard
Cornerstone of the Castleward Urban Village regeneration

specification.heading: Specification
items: Services: mains electrical services; cold water services sourced from central storage tank and boosted to each flat/apartment
Heating and hot water: wall-mounted electric panel heaters with smart WiFi controls; hot water generated via electric hot water cylinder
Electrical: brushed stainless steel effect sockets and switches throughout apartments

Kitchen: contemporary kitchens with fitted floor and wall units and modern post-formed laminate worktops; includes electric cooker hob and extractor, built-in fridge/freezer, integrated dishwasher and integrated washer/dryer in all apartments

Sanitaryware: Duravit sanitaryware and Hansgrohe brassware, boosted hot water; one beds have a bath with a shower over; two beds have an en-suite shower room with shower tray and screen, with a bath to the second bathroom
Doors: contemporary doors throughout including brushed stainless steel ironmongery; fire-rated doors where applicable
Skirting and architrave: pencil round skirting and architrave finished in white eggshell paint
Decoration: white emulsion paint to all plastered walls and ceilings
Ceramic tiling: Porcelanosa tiles to bathroom floors and part-tiled walls in wet areas
Flooring: carpets in bedrooms and laminate throughout other than in wet areas
Door entry: keypad entry with intercom access from apartments
TV distribution: digital aerial and signal distribution to TV point in each apartment
Telephone and data: Block A – BT Fibre; Blocks B & C – BT Fibre data cable to a single outlet in living room

locationNotes: Nestled between Derby train station and Castleward Park, a short stroll from the River Derwent. Walking times: Derbion shopping centre 1 min; Bustler Market 3 min; Derby Theatre 6 min; Showcase Cinema de Lux 6 min. By train from Derby: Nottingham 22 min, Leicester 20 min, Birmingham 34 min, Leeds 77 min, London St Pancras 87 min, Manchester 92 min. East Midlands Airport is under 30 minutes away by road.
